items.q: What does he say the CVE spike is?
items.a: Labs **finding bugs in old human code**, including a **cache-timing** signal from a VM. Norwegian **KERN** agents with Playwright scanned **more than 1,200 sites** and entered **more than 100**.

items.q: What did Anthropic's 16 October note say?
items.a: Among **192** agent users versus **74** others, commits per engineer were about **5×**. About **80%** of session time was idle. Junior technical-hire share went from **27% to 9%**, employment from **21% to 14%**, since early 2025.

Cycle time **down 90%**, underwriting **down 95%**, about **76,000 hours**, **more than $50 million** of capacity, revenue per employee **up 13%**, pretax profit per employee **up 34%**. Samvir Sidhu is the name he gives.

items.q: What does he tell people to buy?
items.a: A frontier plan at **$100 to $200**, plus **context, memory, and better questions**. Gartner heard from about **2,000** CTOs and CIOs, and only **13%** reported amazing gains. The line is **growth over automation**, and **the only way out is through**.
